description: Site: deviation.rs:920-938. DeviationRunner::run_path matches on chain.first(): Some(leaf) → apply_deviations(raw, leaf, now_unix); None → return raw findings unmodified. Doc says 'If the chain is empty (shouldn\'t happen after validate_path), fall back to no scope matching (treat as Any).' But: chain.is_empty() means validate_path has not been called (validate_path produces ValidatedPath on success and the chain is non-empty), or the caller is misusing the API. Treating it as 'no scope match' silently produces a partial result. Suggested rewrite: change run_path to return Result<DeviationRunResult, EmptyChainError> or, alternatively, debug_assert!(!chain.is_empty(), 'run_path requires at least one cert'). The current behavior is the worst of both worlds — accepts invalid input silently while documenting it as a known edge case. Filed P3 because the trigger is API misuse, not a normal flow.
title: run_path on empty chain silently uses 'no scope match' fallback instead of erroring or NotApplicable
